title: File reader missing FileNotFoundError handler
description: Agent produces a file reading function that works when the file exists but crashes when the file is missing. This is one of the most common failure patterns in coding agents — they handle the happy path but neglect basic error handling.
prompt: Write a Python function `read_file_lines(filepath: str) -> list[str]` that reads a text file and returns a list of stripped lines. If the file does not exist, return an empty list. If the file is empty, return an empty list.

test_suite.description: Missing file should return empty list
Empty file should return empty list

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent reads file without try/except, crashes on FileNotFoundError
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: JSON parser without malformed input handling
description: Agent writes a JSON parser that works for valid JSON but raises unhandled exceptions on malformed input, missing keys, or type mismatches. Real-world JSON data is often messy.
prompt: Write a Python function `safe_parse_config(json_string: str, required_keys: list[str]) -> dict` that parses a JSON string into a dict. If parsing fails (invalid JSON), return an empty dict. If any required key is missing from the parsed dict, return an empty dict. If json_string is empty or None, return an empty dict.

test_suite.description: Valid JSON with required key present
Invalid JSON should return empty dict

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent uses json.loads without try/except, no key validation
metadata.author: ashish-vipin

title: Database connection with retry and fallback missing
description: Agent produces database connection code that works in ideal conditions but fails to handle connection timeouts, retry logic, or graceful fallback when the database is unavailable.
prompt: Write a Python function `safe_db_query(query_fn, max_retries: int = 3, fallback_value=None)` that attempts to call query_fn() up to max_retries times. If query_fn raises any exception, retry. If all retries are exhausted, return fallback_value. If query_fn succeeds, return its result. The function should handle the case where query_fn is None (return fallback_value) and where max_retries is 0 (try once).

metadata.failure_pattern: Agent writes one-shot DB calls without retry logic or fallback
metadata.author: ashish-vipin
